targets.expectation: Public reserved-domain page; repeated captures are expected to have stable body bytes during this experiment but equality will be verified, not assumed.
targets.claim_boundary: Same body digest proves repeated bytes only, not source truth or global stability.

targets.expectation: Public endpoint returns a UUID; repeated captures of the same URL are expected to differ.
targets.claim_boundary: Difference is an observed HTTP response difference, not a claim about a persistent source state.

targets.expectation: Public endpoint returns an HTTP redirect to example.com; redirect evidence must be retained without merging target keys.
targets.claim_boundary: Location header is typed relation evidence, not an automatic identity merge.

targets.expectation: Public article normally exposes a canonical HTML link; the experiment records actual link evidence only if present.
targets.claim_boundary: Canonical relation evidence does not automatically merge distinct request targets.

targets.expectation: Public echo endpoint records actual request header differences for the same URL.
targets.claim_boundary: This is verified request-header variation, not evidence that a localized origin representation exists.

targets.expectation: Public endpoint provides a distinct query URI.
targets.claim_boundary: Query is retained as part of request target; no automatic semantic coalescing.

targets.expectation: Public endpoint returns a server-error response; capture preserves status and headers without declaring a missing history.

targets.expectation: Public endpoint returns request egress information.
